rationale.verdict: The Hyperliquid Spot Orderbook is implemented as a native component of the HyperBFT-secured HyperCore execution layer, not as addressable smart contracts. Standard discovery methods (block-explorer searches, GitHub artifact inspection, audit scope tables) do not yield contract addresses. The system is state-based and protocol-native, rendering traditional contract enumeration infeasible without access to HyperCore gRPC APIs or the official HyperCore validator documentation—neither of which are pre-pinned or publicly accessible via web_fetch.

protocol_metadata.about: Hyperliquid is a Layer 1 blockchain that runs a fully on-chain central limit order book for spot trading. The spot orderbook is a native component of HyperCore, the protocol's execution layer, matching orders with price-time priority and settling trades atomically within a single block. Users trade spot assets with self-custody of collateral.
